desc: Derive and verify the subset/permutation-count formula for the contribution of a fixed element.
Count values by digit length and compute the sum of values in each length group modulo \(998244353\).
Build \(G(z)=\prod_d(1+10^d z)^{c_d}\) efficiently and compute all coefficients modulo \(998244353\).
For each digit length, obtain coefficients of \(G(z)/(1+10^d z)\) and apply factorial arrangement weights.
Accumulate group contributions and validate the complete implementation on edge cases and all public samples.
